items.summary: WLWT (NBC, Cincinnati) reports in-person early voting in southwest Ohio rose sharply across the first four early-voting days, outpacing the 2022 midterms; Hamilton County commenters cite Democrats casting 56% of in-person ballots Tue-Fri. Adds to the Ohio picture already in the feed (SoS tally: 228,470 statewide through ~Oct 12; CNN/Catalist: Dems overperforming even in Trump-friendly counties). Single-sourced - local-station original, no second outlet yet.
items.title: In-person early voting rises sharply in southwest Ohio
